basic_info.description: Legal ADU Marina-style home in the Outer Sunset district of San Francisco. Featuring 3 bedrooms 2.5 baths with timeless architecture and tasteful modern upgrades in an amazing location truly is the real definition of classic charm and convenience. Be greeted by a sunlit living room with a traditional fireplace, flowing into the dining area and updated kitchen. Two generously sized bedrooms sit quietly at the rear of the home, offering privacy and peaceful retreat. Along with the full bathroom with contemporary touches. One car garage for secure parking and ample storage. Outside, the backyard, a serene space for gardening and entertaining. Ideally located just blocks away from Golden Gate Park and Ocean Beach, excellent schools, many shopping and dining options, and easy access to public transportation. With its perfect blend of classic San Francisco charm, thoughtful modern upgrades, and the unbeatable Outer Sunset location, this home offers a lifestyle that's both effortlessly relaxed and deeply connected. Wake up to ocean air, spend weekends exploring nearby trails and beaches, and enjoy the ease of having cafes, parks, and transit just blocks from your door.
